items.reason: Identifies the duplicated grantType null check that leaves rawTokenId unvalidated.

Identifies both the incorrect grant substring offset and inverted equality check in isAccessTokenId.

Describes stale grantType after setFormParams() and an unguarded null formParams lookup in the context constructor. These are separate from the missing grant attributes in the issuance paths covered by issue #05.

Describes token issuance throwing for an unmapped grant instead of using a fallback. This differs from the abstract-method compatibility break, missing grant attributes, and shortcut collisions in the golden set.
Identifies the duplicated grantType check and missing rawTokenId validation.
Identifies the Javadoc advertising three-letter shortcuts despite the two-character format.
Identifies the inverted grant comparison in isAccessTokenId, one of the defects covered by this issue.

Identifies the duplicated grantType null check that allows null rawTokenId.
Identifies the same incorrect grant offset and inverted comparison in the matcher.
Identifies the inverted equality check that rejects a matching extracted grant shortcut.
Identifies the matcher extracting the token/grant boundary instead of the grant shortcut at substring(4,6).
Identifies both matcher defects that prevent event assertions from verifying grant type.
